en: A vintage monochrome illustrated postcard showing a townscape with a central church featuring a tall nave, pitched roof, and a small tower with a spire. Around it are clustered houses and larger multi‑story buildings, with trees interspersed and low hills in the distant background. The bottom margin contains red printed greeting text in Czech, and a publisher line in smaller type. A red handwritten number "1342" appears in the upper right margin.
